neighbours.label: the ellipsis token '....' in informal prose
fire: I kept calling and calling.... nobody picked up.
We waited for the bus.... it never came.
She opened the box slowly.... and gasped.
Well.... I guess that could work for now.
The movie started great.... then it fell apart.
He said he'd be back soon.... that was hours ago.
So many emails today.... I need a break.
The test was hard.... really hard.
